title: Expand released StackKits public guides and examples
description: Extend the canonical Mintlify StackKits documentation with release-backed website installation paths, verified one-line installer guidance, practical configuration examples, focused how-to guides, deeper module pages, and richer use cases without reintroducing unreleased or internal product scope.
design: Treat kombifyio/StackKits v0.16.0 public tag and release assets as capability authority. Treat https://stackkit.cc and its live installer endpoints as the user-facing installation path only after verification. Keep Standard Mode standalone and exclude unreleased or hosted-product behavior.

notes: Shipped content via PR #50. Exact production deployment PASS at merged main 2c68355ecc0425ce0cffbad43d61ffab6c092d02, deployment 5848100169, environment https://docs.kombify.io. Live public routes for quickstart, StackSpec, private files, Cloudreve, and identity return 200; all 18 forbidden legacy routes return 404; llms.txt and sitemap projections are safe. Closeout also fixes the Windows exact-SHA wrapper and keeps the remote forbidden-route gate fail-closed with an explicit curl status fallback for Mintlify connection-close responses.
